sections.title: The Leap from Concrete to Abstract
lecture_lines: Vectors are arrows in 2D space. [Asset: arrow]
Space acts like a system of rules. [Asset: rules]
Abstract objects follow these exact rules. [Asset: objects]
We generalize beyond 2D coordinate grids. [Asset: grid]
Vector spaces define this unified structure. [Asset: structure]
animations: Create 2D vector in coordinate grid (color: #FF6600, label: v).
Fade out grid, morph v into an abstract symbol (color: #00CCFF, label: s).
Transition symbol s into a function curve (color: #FFFF00, label: f(x)) using to indicate direction.
Label the collection of symbols as a 'System'.
Highlight the system with a bounding box (color: #FFFFFF).

sections.title: The Rules of the Game: Defining Vector Spaces
lecture_lines: Vector addition combines two ingredients. [Asset: add]
Scalar multiplication scales our ingredients. [Asset: scale]
Closure means the result stays valid. [Asset: closure]
We check eight required axioms. [Asset: axioms]
The system is a vector space. [Asset: space]
animations: Display 8 axioms on screen in a grid list.
Visualize vector addition: V1 (red) + V2 (blue) = V_sum (green).
Visualize scalar multiplication: c * V (color: #FF00FF).
Animate a ticking off the 8 axioms.
Mark the structure as a 'Vector Space' in bold.

sections.title: Case Study: Beyond Geometric Arrows
lecture_lines: Polynomials behave just like geometric vectors. [Asset: poly]
Functions also follow vector space rules. [Asset: func]
Zero polynomial acts as our zero. [Asset: zero]
Algebraic structure defines both categories. [Asset: structure]
Abstraction links disparate mathematical objects. [Asset: link]
animations: Display arrow vector (v) at screen left.
Display polynomial P(x) = ax^2 + bx + c at screen right.
Show equality: v (arrow) = P(x) (polynomial) using an equals sign.
Show zero vector (0) becoming zero polynomial (0(x)).
Draw a connector between the two entities.

sections.title: Visualizing Abstract Dimensions
lecture_lines: Dimension counts our necessary basis elements. [Asset: basis]
Pixels build a full image character. [Asset: image]
Linear combinations create the final object. [Asset: linear]
Changing coefficients shifts the result. [Asset: shift]
Basis defines the space's internal dimensionality. [Asset: dim]
animations: Display a complex image in the center.
Show it decomposing into two simpler basis components.
Adjust coefficients of basis components with sliders.
Observe the final image changing based on coefficients.
Label the final result as 'Linear Combination'.

sections.title: Summary and Real-World Application
lecture_lines: Abstract spaces unify diverse data types. [Asset: unify]
Geometry applies to signals and weights. [Asset: app]
Mathematical toolboxes solve complex problems. [Asset: tools]
animations: Display audio wave on screen.
Display 3D arrow vector on screen.
Show the 'Math Toolbox' (a central icon) processing both.
